name: Galisteo (Spain)
description: Quartered, the first and fourth quarters red with two cauldrons chequy of yellow and black in pale with green serpents issuing from the handles, the second and third white with a brown castle.
history: The arms and the flag of Galisteo were approved by the Order of 12 June 1989 of the Consejería de la Presidencia y Trabajo published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 22 June 1989, after the municipal council's approval on 8 May 1987; the flag is quartered, the first and fourth red with two cauldrons chequy of yellow and black set in pale and gringolé with six green serpents issuing from their handles.

features.role: two cauldrons chequy yellow and black in each red quarter
serpents issuing from the cauldron handles
